description: LOCAL Deep Optimize has no wall-clock time limit — runs all gens to completion. 60 main + 60 opposite objective gens (retain phase-1 DPS floor via elite carryover). Complete tree mutation with connectivity repair, skill-point budget, and Split Personality zigzag repositioning.

phases.main: Maximize DPS / mana scaling (RF Arcane Devotion spell damage) — 60 gens × 60 pop
phases.opposite: Maximize regen + eHP while retaining >=92% phase-1 DPS — 60 gens × 60 pop seeded from phase-1 elites

splitPersonality.rule: 25% increased effect per Allocated Passive Skill between jewel and class start
splitPersonality.strategy: Place SP jewels on farthest sockets; prefer zigzag (longer allocated path) over shortest path when it increases path length
